name: Street Racing
description: Your reputation in the underground racing scene

en.name: Phase 0 - The Weight of Silence
en.intro:
The Miramar sits in the garage, faithful as ever.
Beside it, covered in dust, lies a chassis that once held dreams.
A letter from your grandfather waits on the workbench.
en.completion: Ghost reaches out. A cryptic message. The legacy calls.

es.name: Fase 0 - El Peso del Silencio
es.intro:
El Miramar descansa en el garaje, fiel como siempre.
A su lado, cubierto de polvo, yace un chasis que una vez guardó sueños.
Una carta de tu abuelo espera en el banco de trabajo.
es.completion: Ghost se comunica. Un mensaje críptico. El legado llama.

description.heading: Origins / Orígenes
description.description: Racing among friends, but tensions rise.

unlocks.heading: Techie Contact
unlocks.description: Access to ECU and electronics shop.

en.name: Phase 1 - Origins
en.intro:
Rook drives with precision, respecting every component.
Nova pushes limits, seeking adrenaline.
You are the third vertex of a complicated triangle.
en.completion: Techie unlocked. The philosophy clash deepens. Who will you follow?

es.name: Fase 1 - Orígenes
es.intro:
Rook conduce con precisión, respetando cada componente.
Nova empuja límites, buscando adrenalina.
Tú eres el tercer vértice de un triángulo complicado.
es.completion: Techie desbloqueado. El choque filosófico se profundiza. ¿A quién seguirás?

description.heading: The Split / La Grieta
description.description: Tension escalates. The team starts cracking.

en.name: Phase 2 - The Split
en.intro:
Nova wants to risk everything on underground races.
Rook desperately tries to maintain control.
A newspaper clipping reveals your grandfather's past.
en.completion: Muscle recognizes the ETK-I. The accident that broke your grandfather is no longer a secret.

es.name: Fase 2 - La Grieta
es.intro:
Nova quiere arriesgar todo en carreras underground.
Rook intenta desesperadamente mantener el control.
Un recorte de periódico revela el pasado de tu abuelo.
es.completion: Muscle reconoce el ETK-I. El accidente que rompió a tu abuelo ya no es secreto.

en.name: Phase 3 - The Crisis
en.intro:
Nova and Rook's relationship is unstable.
Each race is a battlefield of philosophies.
Shadow enters the scene with forbidden offers.
en.completion: Nova approaches you in private. She wants to leave this town. Shadow has what you need... for a price.

es.name: Fase 3 - La Crisis
es.intro:
La relación de Nova y Rook es inestable.
Cada carrera es un campo de batalla de filosofías.
Shadow entra en escena con ofertas prohibidas.
es.completion: Nova te aborda en privado. Quiere dejar este pueblo. Shadow tiene lo que necesitas... por un precio.

description.heading: The Split (Final) / Ruptura Final
description.description: The team breaks. You must choose.

en.name: Phase 4 - The Split (Final Rupture)
en.intro:
The tension explodes mid-race.
Rook and Nova publicly break up over the radio.
You are forced to take a side through your words.
en.completion: The team is shattered. Shadow offers a way out... through debt.

es.name: Fase 4 - La Ruptura Final
es.intro:
La tensión explota en plena carrera.
Rook y Nova rompen públicamente por la radio.
Te ves forzado a elegir un bando con tus palabras.
es.completion: El equipo está destrozado. Shadow ofrece una salida... a través de deudas.

en.name: Phase 5 - Dust and Betrayal
en.intro:
The ETK-I is complete. Ghost warns you to watch your back.
The rally is your stage. The world sees the Miller name again.
But after your victory, everything goes dark.
en.completion: You wake up. The car is gone. A voice echoes: 'Viper will love the gift.'

es.name: Fase 5 - Polvo y Traición
es.intro:
El ETK-I está completo. Ghost te advierte que cuides tu espalda.
El rally es tu escenario. El mundo ve el nombre Miller de nuevo.
Pero tras tu victoria, todo se oscurece.
es.completion: Despiertas. El coche ha desaparecido. Una voz resuena: 'Viper estará encantada con el regalo.'

en.name: Phase 6 - Rock Bottom
en.intro:
Without the ETK-I, you're nobody.
Ghost gives you money for a junkyard Covet.
Techie shows you 'evidence': your partner sold you out to Shadow.
en.completion: You win the Covet Cup, but your heart is broken. The one you trusted betrayed you... or did they?

es.name: Fase 6 - El Fondo del Pozo
es.intro:
Sin el ETK-I, no eres nadie.
Ghost te da dinero para un Covet de desguace.
Techie te muestra 'evidencia': tu pareja te vendió a Shadow.
es.completion: Ganas la Copa Covet, pero tu corazón está roto. Quien confiabas te traicionó... ¿o no?

description.heading: Clasificatorias / Qualifiers
description.description: The truth emerges. Shadow's web unravels.

unlocks.heading: Big One Qualifiers
unlocks.description: Qualifying series for The Big One.

en.name: Phase 7 - The Iron Trail
en.intro:
You see ETK-I parts on rival cars. Shadow is selling it piecemeal.
Anonymous messages hint: 'Shadow is a master of digital mirages.'
Your partner returns, injured but alive. The truth is revealed.
en.completion: It was all a lie. Shadow orchestrated everything. Now he challenges you: 'Beat me for your car.'

es.name: Fase 7 - El Rastro del Hierro
es.intro:
Ves piezas del ETK-I en coches rivales. Shadow lo está vendiendo por partes.
Mensajes anónimos insinúan: 'Shadow es un maestro de los espejismos digitales.'
Tu pareja regresa, herida pero viva. La verdad se revela.
es.completion: Todo era mentira. Shadow lo orquestó todo. Ahora te desafía: 'Gáname por tu coche.'

unlocks.heading: The Big One
unlocks.description: The legendary race your grandfather dreamed of.

en.name: Phase 8 - Reclamation and Glory
en.intro:
You duel Shadow. He drives YOUR ETK-I.
You win. The keys return to your hands.
Viper watches from the paddock. She recognizes the car... and you.
en.completion:
The Big One. Grandfather's unfinished dream.
You race not just for yourself, but for both of you.
The garage is finally at peace.

es.name: Fase 8 - Reclamación y Gloria
es.intro:
Te bates con Shadow. Él conduce TU ETK-I.
Ganas. Las llaves vuelven a tus manos.
Viper observa desde el paddock. Reconoce el coche... y a ti.
es.completion:
The Big One. El sueño inacabado del abuelo.
Corres no solo por ti, sino por ambos.
El garaje finalmente está en paz.
